guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 检查你的 ARX 资格
guide.description: 前往 Arcium RTG portal 或 Magna portal，打开资格检查器。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Arcium RTG portal or use the Magna portal and open the eligibility checker.

guide.title: 连接你的 Solana 钱包
guide.description: 连接 Solana 钱包，例如 Phantom、Solflare 或 Backpack。批准连接，以便 portal 可以读取你的贡献历史记录以及与你的钱包或 Discord 身份相关的任何分配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Connect a Solana wallet such as Phantom, Solflare, or Backpack. Approve the connection so the portal can read your contribution history and any allocation tied to your wallet or Discord identity.

guide.title: 查看你的 RTG 分配
guide.description: 检查加密的 portal 中显示的分配。零余额并不总是意味着被排除，因为你的贡献可能仍在审核中或为稍后的 RTG 轮次。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Check the allocation shown in the encrypted portal. A zero balance does not always mean exclusion, as your contributions may still be under review or set for a later RTG wave.

guide.title: 领取你的 ARX 代币
guide.description: 如果你有分配，请在你的钱包中确认领取交易。手头保留少量 SOL 以支付 Solana 网络费用。交易结算后，你的 ARX 将到达连接的钱包中。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If you have an allocation, confirm the claim transaction in your wallet. Keep a small amount of SOL on hand to cover the Solana network fee. Your ARX will arrive in the connected wallet once the transaction settles.

guide.title: 通过 Binance Alpha 领取
guide.description: 来源称交易开放后，符合条件的 Binance 用户可在 Alpha Events 页面使用 Binance Alpha Points 领取 ARX。原文流程为创建或登录 Binance、打开 Alpha Events，再按页面说明核对并领取 ARX。交易所及跨链组件推广已省略，活动资格和当前有效性待官方核验。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Eligible Binance users can claim ARX with Binance Alpha Points on the Alpha Events page once trading is open. Create or log in to Binance , or swap and bridge funds using the widget below, open Alpha Events, and follow the on-screen claim steps for ARX. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 在未来的 RTG 浪潮中继续赚取收入
guide.description: 如果你还没有分配，请通过 portal 内的 RTG 目录提交新的贡献。跨开发者、生态系统和社区轨道的工作可以获得加密积分，这些积分可以在未来的浪潮中转换为 ARX。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Keep Earning in Future RTG Waves
guide.original_description: If you have no allocation yet, submit new contributions through the RTG Directory inside the portal. Work across the Developer, Ecosystem, and Community tracks earns Encrypted Credits that can convert to ARX in a future wave.

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
相关活动信息待核实，请查看官方公告。

sourcedSteps.title: Check Your ARX Eligibility
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Arcium RTG portal or use the Magna portal and open the eligibility checker.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect Your Solana Wallet
sourcedSteps.body: Connect a Solana wallet such as Phantom, Solflare, or Backpack. Approve the connection so the portal can read your contribution history and any allocation tied to your wallet or Discord identity.

sourcedSteps.title: Review Your RTG Allocation
sourcedSteps.body: Check the allocation shown in the encrypted portal. A zero balance does not always mean exclusion, as your contributions may still be under review or set for a later RTG wave.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Your ARX Tokens
sourcedSteps.body: If you have an allocation, confirm the claim transaction in your wallet. Keep a small amount of SOL on hand to cover the Solana network fee. Your ARX will arrive in the connected wallet once the transaction settles.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Through Binance Alpha
sourcedSteps.body: Eligible Binance users can claim ARX with Binance Alpha Points on the Alpha Events page once trading is open. Create or log in to Binance , or swap and bridge funds using the widget below, open Alpha Events, and follow the on-screen claim steps for ARX.
